articles.title: HashKey taps Hong Kong's first regulated stablecoin to settle insurance and trade deals
articles.snippet: Following institutional trials, the HKD-pegged asset is being put to work to capture part of Hong Kong's $49 billion trade corridor with the United Arab Emirates

articles.title: Cash App's crypto support expands beyond bitcoin and USDC via MoonPay
articles.snippet: Eligible Cash App users will be able to use their balances to purchase digital assets offered by MoonPay, which include ether, solana and stablecoin USDT.

articles.title: Visa looking for new stablecoin settlement partner after BVNK sale to Mastercard
articles.snippet: Visa’s request for product (RFP) talks about the need to support a range of stablecoins.

articles.title: XRP sinks below $1 for first time since 2024 even as Korean bank adopts Ripple Payments
articles.snippet: Jeonbuk Bank will use Ripple’s 24/7 cross-border payment service for business remittances, but it is unknown whether the flows will use XRP or Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin.

articles.title: US Treasury moves forward with rules on GENIUS Act after July deadline
articles.snippet: The stablecoin bill signed into law last year is scheduled to go into effect in January 2027, potentially without finalized regulations from US government agencies.
